# Daemon Data

> Daemon Data publishes 27 public Actors on Apify Store (https://apify.com/data_daemon), verified at build time against the Apify API. Data Actors read public JSON endpoints or pages and return structured records (JSON, CSV, Excel). Most charge per record; India Jobs Feed and India Jobs MCP have no own fee, with downstream board Actor charges. Call via REST, Python/Node.js, n8n/Make/Zapier or MCP (`https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=data_daemon/<actor>`, header `Authorization: Bearer <APIFY_TOKEN>`). FREE-plan list prices checked 2026-11-06. Historical measurements retain their stated dates.

- [India job board data compared: IIMJobs, Hirist, Foundit and Instahyre as APIs](https://datadmon.github.io/guides/india-job-boards-data-compared/): Which Indian job board to pull data from for recruiters, aggregators and hiring-signal research: coverage, fields (salary, applicants, company profile), freshness and price per 1,000 jobs, measured in October 2026.
- [Oracle Recruiting Cloud career sites: how to export every job of an employer as JSON](https://datadmon.github.io/guides/oracle-recruiting-cloud-career-sites-export/): How to recognise an Oracle Recruiting Cloud (Oracle HCM) career site, how many jobs large employers list on them (Kotak 16,521, Marriott 13,286, JPMorgan 7,262 in October 2026), and how to export all of them, or only the new ones each day, as JSON for $2 per 1,000.
- [UK winding-up petitions and insolvency notices as a daily JSON feed from The Gazette](https://datadmon.github.io/guides/uk-winding-up-petitions-daily-feed/): How many winding-up petitions and administrations The Gazette publishes each week (October 2026), which notice-type codes to use, what the linked-data record adds (company number, registered office), and how to run a daily feed for about $3 a month.

# Apna (apna.co) jobs with salaries as JSON API | Daemon Data

Source: https://datadmon.github.io/actors/apna-jobs-scraper/

Apna (apna.co) jobs with salaries as JSON API

Apna Jobs Scraper is a pay-per-record Apify Actor by Daemon Data that returns Apna (apna.co) India jobs with salary, locality, department, work mode and full descriptions; full-board export as JSON, CSV or Excel. It costs $0.0008 per job with the default options ($0.80 per 1,000); no login to the source site and no proxy or browser to set up on your side, and the same input runs from the Apify console, one REST call, Python, Node.js, n8n or an AI assistant through MCP.

Daemon Data Apna Jobs Scraper on Apify   Listing as plain text

Checked on 26 Oct 2026
Delhi-NCR 4,940 open jobs, Bengaluru 3,650, Mumbai 3,400, Hyderabad 1,770, Pune 1,770. By department: Sales & BD 12,540, Banking / Insurance / Financial Services 9,930, Delivery / Driver / Logistics 4,410, Software Engineering 4,280, Finance & Accounting 4,010. There were 8,930 field jobs and 2,960 part-time jobs.

Who uses it, for what
You areWhat you get
Job aggregators and job-alert appsApna as a source: stable ids, salary, locality, department, full description and a board-wide daily feed (All jobs + Last 24 hours + only-new). Same conventions as the IIMJobs, Hirist, Foundit, Instahyre and Unstop Actors by the same publisher.
Staffing agencies and recruitersWho is hiring telecallers, delivery riders or field sales staff in your city this week, at what salary, with how many openings.
Labour-market and salary analystsEntry-level and frontline salaries by city, department and role, the share of field and night-shift jobs, demand trends by locality.
B2B sales and lead generationA company posting 20 delivery openings in Pune is expanding there. Each row has the company name and Apna organisation id.
HR-tech, skilling and government programmesWhich jobs ask for ITI, a diploma or 12th pass, and the English level required, by district.
AI agents (MCP)Ask Claude or ChatGPT "new telecaller jobs in Jaipur posted today with salary" and let it call this Actor through Apify's MCP server.

Output fields
The most useful top-level fields with values from a real record; the full list is id, url, title, company, companyId, companyLogo, department, category, role, city, state, area, pincode, latitude, longitude, locationText, workMode, employmentType, shift, salaryMin, salaryMax, salaryCurrency, salaryPeriod, salaryLooksYearly, earningPotential, incentives, experienceMinYears, experienceMaxYears, experienceText, education, englishLevel, openings, tags, isExternalJob, externalApplyUrl, postedAt, updatedAt, expiresAt, description, searchTerm, scrapedAt. Per-field notes and the OpenAPI definition are on the Apify API page.

Input and how to call it

Example input. Fields and pricing were checked against the public listing on 2026-11-06; this build does not run paid example searches.

{
  "cities": [
    "Pune"
  ],
  "departments": [
    "Delivery / Driver / Logistics"
  ],
  "postedWithin": "7d",
  "maxJobsPerSearch": 50
}

One HTTP call starts a run, waits for it and returns the records (token from console.apify.com):

curl -X POST "https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/data_daemon~apna-jobs-scraper/run-sync-get-dataset-items?token=YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"cities": ["Pune"], "departments": ["Delivery / Driver / Logistics"], "postedWithin": "7d", "maxJobsPerSearch": 50}'

Python: ApifyClient(token).actor("data_daemon/apna-jobs-scraper").call(run_input=...). Python example · Node.js example · n8n workflow.
AI assistant (MCP): add the remote server https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=data_daemon/apna-jobs-scraper with header Authorization: Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN in Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or VS Code and ask for the data in plain words.

All input fields
FieldTypeMeaning
searchTermsarrayJob titles or skills, e.g. telecaller, delivery boy, accountant, python developer, driver. One Apna search per keyword; Apna returns at most 500 jobs per keyword. Leave empty for the latest jobs, filtered by city, department and the options below.
allJobsbooleanIgnore the keywords and export every open Apna job, department by department (about 71,000 of the 76,800 open jobs on 26 Oct 2026 carry a department). Combine with Only new jobs since the last run for a daily feed, or with cities / departments to export a slice. Large: set a maximum cost per run.
citiesarrayCity names, e.g. Mumbai, Delhi, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Kolkata, Ahmedabad, Jaipur, Lucknow. Apna filters by 74 cities; Delhi, Gurgaon, Noida and Ghaziabad all map to Delhi-NCR. Other place names are matched against each job's location. remote means work from home.
departmentsarrayApna departments, e.g. Sales & BD, Customer Support, Delivery / Driver / Logistics, Software Engineering, Finance & Accounting, Healthcare / Doctor / Hospital Staff, Banking / Insurance / Financial Services. A word such as sales, delivery or healthcare picks the matching department. Applies to runs without keywords.
workModesarrayOnly jobs with these work modes. Empty = any.
workTypestringOnly full-time or only part-time jobs.
shiftstringOnly day-shift or only night-shift jobs.
educationstringJobs open to candidates with this highest education, as Apna filters them.
englishLevelstringJobs open to candidates with this English level, as Apna filters them.
postedWithinstringOnly jobs posted or refreshed by the employer recently (Apna's own windows; a refreshed job keeps its original postedAt). Last 24 hours with All jobs is a daily board-wide feed of about 2,000 jobs on an average day.
includeDescriptionbooleanFull job description as plain text. Keyword searches fetch each job page for it (slower); the feed already carries it. Price is the same either way.
maxJobsPerSearchintegerCap for each keyword (or each city / department listing). 0 = no cap. Not used with All jobs.
maxJobsintegerStop after this many saved jobs. 0 or empty = no total cap (the run's maximum cost still applies).
onlyNewSinceLastRunbooleanFor schedules: remember delivered job ids (in a named key-value store in your account) and save only jobs that earlier runs with the same settings did not deliver. Skipped jobs are not charged.
stateNamestringName of the only-new memory. Empty = derived from the keywords and filters. Give two schedules the same name to share one memory.
skipJobIdsarrayApna job ids you already have (the id field). They are neither saved nor charged.

Price
$0.0008 per job ($0.80 per 1,000); $0.001 per run. List prices for Apify Free and Starter plans; Scale and Business plans pay 15% to 30% less.
EventPricePer 1,000Charged when
Job$0.0008$0.80One Apna job saved to the dataset: id, URL, title, company, department, role, city, area, PIN code, coordinates, work mode, shift, salary range and earning potential, experience, education and English level asked for, openings, tags, dates and the full description. Skipped or filtered jobs are never charged.
Actor Start$0.001Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).
Cost example: 50 jobs with default options cost $0.041, including any start fee. This is an illustrative record count; set explicit row and total-charge caps for your run. Apify's free plan includes $5 of usage a month, about 6,250 jobs before start fees; the Actor's own compute is included in the per-record price, and records skipped by filters, de-duplication or only-new mode are not charged.

All Apna jobs from the last 24 hours: full-board daily feed: Every job posted or refreshed on Apna (apna.co) in the last 24 hours, across all departments: about 2,000 on an average day (2,533 on 28 October 2026), capped at 3,000. Turn on only-new mode and schedule it daily for a f {"allJobs": true, "postedWithin": "24h", "includeDescription": true, "maxJobs": 3000}

Questions buyers ask
Is there an official Apna API?
Not a public one. This Actor reads the public JSON job feed and job pages that the apna.co website loads. It exposes them as a REST API with schedules, webhooks and only-new runs.
Does it return candidates or recruiter contacts?
No. It returns job listings only: no candidate data, and no recruiter names, phone numbers or e-mail addresses.
Why do some jobs have no salary?
The employer did not disclose it, or the job is an external listing applied for on the employer's own career site.
Do I need a proxy or login?
No.

Alternatives, honestly

careerSiteUrlsarrayCompany careers pages on Workday (https://nvidia.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/NVIDIAExternalCareerSite), Greenhouse (https://boards.greenhouse.io/airbnb), Lever (https://jobs.lever.co/palantir), Ashby (https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/ramp) or SmartRecruiters (https://jobs.smartrecruiters.com/BoschGroup). keywordsarrayKeep jobs whose title contains all words of any keyword (data engineer, account executive). Prefix match: engineer also matches "Engineering". Empty = all jobs.
excludeKeywordsarrayDrop jobs whose title matches any of these (same matching as title keywords), e.g. senior, intern. Applied before anything is charged.
locationsarrayKeep jobs whose location or country contains any of these (New York, London, Remote). Country names also match the country's code and big cities, so United States finds "San Francisco, CA" and India finds "Bengaluru". Empty = everywhere.
workplaceTypesarrayKeep only these workplace types (as the employer states them). Empty = all.
postedWithinDaysintegerOnly jobs first published in the last N days. Empty = all open jobs (cross-company search: last 7 days).
includeDescriptionbooleanOn (default): the full job description as text and HTML. Workday and SmartRecruiters read each job page for it; the price is the same either way.

maxJobsintegerStop the run after this many jobs in total. Empty = no limit for your own career sites, 100 for a cross-company search; 0 = no limit.
searchAllCompaniesbooleanOn: search the built-in company list as well as the career-site URLs you gave. Off (default): the list is searched only when no URL is given.
platformsarrayCross-company search only: search companies on these platforms. Empty = all five.
maxCompaniesintegerCross-company search only: search at most this many companies from the list (most active boards first, platforms mixed). Empty or 0 = the whole list, within the time limit.
maxSearchSecondsintegerCross-company search: stop searching after this many seconds and finish with the jobs found. Default 240, so a synchronous API call (5-minute limit) gets its results; 0 = until the run timeout. With 'Also search the built-in company list' on, the limit covers your own URLs too.
compatibleOutputbooleanAlso write each job under the key names many existing career-site job API clients read: organization, date_posted, locations_derived, description_text, ai_work_arrangement, ai_salary_min_value, ai_salary_max_value, ai_salary_currency, ai_salary_unit_text, source. Empty = on when the input uses titleSearch, locationSearch, timeRange, ats or another field name of those clients (limit alone does not count), off otherwise.
onlyNewSinceLastRunbooleanOn: deliver only jobs an earlier run with the same stateName (or the same sites and filters) has not delivered; skip the rest without charging. Off (default): every matching job.
stateNamestringOptional name for the only-new memory, e.g. fintech-companies-us. Empty = derived from the sites and filters.
skipJobIdsarrayid or jobId values you already have; skipped and not charged.

minSalaryintegerKeep jobs whose shown annual salary range reaches this amount, e.g. 1500000 for 15 LPA. Jobs that hide their salary (Best in industry) or show a monthly figure are left out when this is set.

stateNamestringName of the only-new memory. By default it follows categories, locations, keywords and the remote setting.
skipIdsarrayCutshort job ids you already have (the 24-character id). Neither saved nor charged.

# Dubai Land Department transactions as JSON API | Daemon Data

Source: https://datadmon.github.io/actors/dubai-property-transactions/

Dubai Land Department transactions as JSON API

Dubai DLD Property Transactions API is a pay-per-record Apify Actor by Daemon Data that returns Dubai Land Department sales, mortgages and gifts with AED value and price/sqm as JSON, CSV or Excel. It costs $0.001 per transaction with the default options ($1.00 per 1,000); no login to the source site and no proxy or browser to set up on your side, and the same input runs from the Apify console, one REST call, Python, Node.js, n8n or an AI assistant through MCP.

Daemon Data Dubai DLD Property Transactions API on Apify   Listing as plain text

Checked on 18 Oct 2026
In the week to 18 Oct 2026 the register recorded about 4,100 transactions: 2,600 sales (1,650 off-plan, 950 ready), 1,300 mortgages and 160 gifts; about 2,500 of the sales were residential and 220 were land plots. On 21 Oct 2026 the last-24-hours example returned 1,000 transactions in 6 seconds.

Why teams use it
Registered prices, not asking prices. Listing portals show what sellers want; DLD shows what buyers actually paid.
Complete. A typical week has 3,000–6,000 transactions; the Actor pages through all of them, 500 at a time.
Analysis-ready. Numeric AED values and areas, ISO dates, boolean off-plan/freehold flags, pricePerSqmAed precomputed, optional Arabic names.
Pre-registration vs completed sale. The procedure field separates developer pre-registrations (Sell - Pre registration) from completed sales (Sale, Delayed Sell), and mortgage registrations from modifications.
Open data, no personal data. Published by the Dubai Land Department for reuse; no owner names or contacts are included.
What a month looks like (1–29 October 2026, run T6ufNxkMMy6eAuIwE):* 16,108 transactions after dedupe: 11,027 sales (6,420 off-plan, 4,607 ready; AED 31.9 billion), 4,123 mortgages and 958 gifts. Off-plan flats registered at a median AED 19,303 per sqm against AED 15,434 for ready flats, with the gap ranging from +7% in Majan to +87% in Motor City; the ten busiest areas took 42% of unit sales. The full area and bedroom tables, with the cleaning steps and a tested pandas snippet, are in Dubai off-plan vs ready prices per sqm by area, October 2026.
From an AI assistant:* add the MCP connector https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=data_daemon/dubai-property-transactions in Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or VS Code and ask for the data in plain words.

Output fields
The most useful top-level fields with values from a real record; the full list is transactionNumber, transactionDate, transactionDateTime, group, groupId, procedure, procedureId, usage, offPlan, freehold, area, areaId, project, masterProject, propertyType, propertySubType, rooms, parking, buildingAge, parcelId, propertyId, transactionValueAed, procedureAreaSqm, actualAreaSqm, pricePerSqmAed, nearestMetro, nearestMall, nearestLandmark, totalSellers, totalBuyers, source, scrapedAt. Per-field notes and the OpenAPI definition are on the Apify API page.

procedurestring"Sale"

freeholdbooleantrue

Input and how to call it

Example input. Fields and pricing were checked against the public listing on 2026-11-06; this build does not run paid example searches.

  "maxItems": 500

One HTTP call starts a run, waits for it and returns the records (token from console.apify.com):

curl -X POST "https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/data_daemon~dubai-property-transactions/run-sync-get-dataset-items?token=YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"transactionGroup": "sales", "maxItems": 500}'

Python: ApifyClient(token).actor("data_daemon/dubai-property-transactions").call(run_input=...). Python example · Node.js example · n8n workflow.
AI assistant (MCP): add the remote server https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=data_daemon/dubai-property-transactions with header Authorization: Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN in Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or VS Code and ask for the data in plain words.

All input fields
FieldTypeMeaning
fromDatestringStart of the transaction date range, YYYY-MM-DD (DD/MM/YYYY also accepted). Leave empty to use Days back instead, so a scheduled run never needs a date edit. An invalid date is ignored with a warning.
toDatestringEnd of the transaction date range, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today (UTC).
daysBackintegerUsed when From date is empty: fetch the last N days up to To date (or today). Default 7, minimum 1, maximum 365; values outside that range are clamped. Set 1 for a daily scheduled feed. All transactions run about 600 rows ($0.60) per working day and 4,000 ($4) per week; DLD registers nothing on weekends, so a weekend run returns 0 rows and costs nothing.
transactionGroupstringFilter by DLD transaction group: all, sales, mortgages or gifts. Weekly volume in Oct 2026: all about 4,000 rows ($4.00), sales about 2,600 ($2.60), mortgages about 1,300 ($1.30), gifts about 160 ($0.16).
offPlanstringOff-plan (developer pre-registration) vs completed properties: all, offplan or ready. Of about 2,600 weekly sales, roughly 1,650 are off-plan and 950 ready.
freeholdstringFreehold vs non-freehold tenure: all, freehold or nonfreehold.
usagestringProperty usage: all, residential or commercial. Of about 2,600 weekly sales, roughly 2,500 are residential and 70 commercial.
propertyTypestringProperty type: all, unit (apartments and villa units), building or land. Land plots are about 220 of the 2,600 weekly sales.
includeArabicbooleanAdd an arabic object with the Arabic names for area, project, procedure etc. No extra charge.
maxItemsintegerStop after this many transactions (0 = all in range). Each transaction costs $0.001, so the default 200 = $0.20 and 2,000 = $2.00. A typical week has 3,000-6,000 transactions.
sortstringSort order by DLD transaction number: TRANSACTION_NUMBER_ASC or TRANSACTION_NUMBER_DESC. Matters only when maxItems cuts the range short.
areaIdstringAdvanced: DLD internal area id, passed through to the gateway. The transactions feed returns areaId 0 on every row and, as of October 2026, 0 rows for any id sent here, so ids cannot be looked up from the output and this filter is not usable. Leave empty and filter on the area name in the results.

Price
$0.001 per transaction ($1.00 per 1,000). List prices for Apify Free and Starter plans; Scale and Business plans pay 15% to 30% less.
EventPricePer 1,000Charged when
Transaction$0.001$1.00One Dubai Land Department transaction record.
Cost example: 500 transactions with default options cost $0.5, including any start fee. This is an illustrative record count; set explicit row and total-charge caps for your run. Apify's free plan includes $5 of usage a month, about 5,000 transactions before start fees; the Actor's own compute is included in the per-record price, and records skipped by filters, de-duplication or only-new mode are not charged.

What it is not for
Listings/asking prices; rental contracts; other emirates. The data belongs to its publisher; the Actor reads public pages and endpoints and leaves out personal contact details.

Questions buyers ask
How much does it cost to get Dubai property transactions?
$0.001 per transaction. A full week of all DLD transactions (about 4,100 rows) costs about $4.10; a week of sales alone about $2.60.
Is this the official DLD data?
Yes. It reads the Dubai Land Department's open-data transactions service, the same register that paid DLD data products resell.
Can I filter by area or off-plan?
Off-plan vs ready, sales / mortgages / gifts, freehold, usage and property type are input filters. For areas, filter the output on the area and project names: DLD's area-id parameter returns no rows and areaId is 0 on every row, so that field is hidden under Advanced.
Does it include price per square metre?
Yes, pricePerSqmAed is computed from the transaction value and the actual area.
Is off-plan cheaper than ready property in Dubai?
Per square metre, no. In the 8,639 residential unit sales registered 1–29 October 2026 the median off-plan flat cost AED 19,303 per sqm, 25% above the ready median of AED 15,434; off-plan units are smaller (68 vs 81 sqm), so the median ticket was almost the same (AED 1.18m vs 1.20m). Area-by-area and bedroom tables: Dubai off-plan vs ready prices per sqm by area, October 2026.
Can I run it every day without editing dates?
Yes. Leave fromDate empty and set daysBack to 1; the window moves with the run date.

Alternatives, honestly
OptionWhat it gives youWhere it falls short for this job
Dubai Pulse open-data portalOfficial downloads by handManual extracts, cleaning needed, no schedule
DXB Interact dashboardOfficial charts and lookupsNot a data feed
Paid DLD data productsCleaned data with supportSubscriptions; the register itself is open data

Input and how to call it

Example input. Fields and pricing were checked against the public listing on 2026-11-06; this build does not run paid example searches.

  "queries": [
    "data analyst"
  ],
  "locations": [
    "Bangalore"
  ],

One HTTP call starts a run, waits for it and returns the records (token from console.apify.com):

curl -X POST "https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/data_daemon~foundit-jobs-scraper/run-sync-get-dataset-items?token=YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"queries": ["data analyst"], "locations": ["Bangalore"], "postedWithinDays": 7, "includeDescription": true, "maxJobsPerQuery": 50}'

Python: ApifyClient(token).actor("data_daemon/foundit-jobs-scraper").call(run_input=...). Python example · Node.js example · n8n workflow.
AI assistant (MCP): add the remote server https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=data_daemon/foundit-jobs-scraper with header Authorization: Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN in Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or VS Code and ask for the data in plain words.

All input fields
FieldTypeMeaning
queriesarrayOne foundit.in search per keyword, e.g. data analyst, java developer, sales manager, chartered accountant, nurse. Use role or skill words; put cities in locations. A job found by two keywords is saved and charged once. Leave the list with one item for a quick first run.
allJobsbooleanIgnore the keywords and deliver every job foundit lists in the posting window: a full-board feed for job aggregators and labour-market tracking. foundit posts about 2,800 jobs a day (2,815 in the last day on 26 Oct 2026), so postedWithinDays defaults to 1 here. locations, experience, salary, job types and maxJobs still apply; the per-keyword cap does not. Combine with Only new jobs since the last run for a daily feed of every new job. You can also put * in the keywords.
locationsarrayOptional. Cities as foundit lists them: Bangalore, Mumbai, Delhi (covers Delhi NCR: Gurugram, Noida), Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune, Kolkata, Ahmedabad, Remote. Several cities = any of them. Applied by the site, then checked on each job. Leave empty for all of India.
minExperienceintegerOnly jobs whose experience range reaches at least this many years (0-30). From 1 upwards this also excludes jobs that do not state an experience range; 0 keeps them.
maxExperienceintegerOnly jobs whose experience range starts at or below this many years (0-30). 0 or 1 is a good fresher filter.
postedWithinDaysintegerOnly jobs posted or refreshed in the last N days (1-365), e.g. 1 with a daily schedule or 7 for a weekly report. Applied by the site and checked again on each job. Leave empty for all open jobs.
jobTypesarrayOptional. Any of Permanent Job, Contract Job, Work From Home, Internship, Temporary. Several values = any of them. Leave empty for all types.
minSalaryLpaintegerOnly jobs whose disclosed annual salary range reaches at least this many lakh INR, e.g. 10 = 10 LPA = 1,000,000 INR. Most foundit jobs do not disclose pay and are excluded when this is set.
maxSalaryLpaintegerOnly jobs whose disclosed annual salary range starts at or below this many lakh INR. Jobs without a disclosed salary are excluded when this is set.
includeDescriptionbooleanOn (default): one extra request per job adds the full description (HTML and plain text), the company profile, skills with the site's own tags, view count and exact city/state/coordinates. The price per job is the same either way. Off: listing fields only, about twice as fast, enough for counting jobs or sizing a market.
sortstringnewest (default): newest postings first, best for feeds and schedules. relevance: the site's own ranking, best when you only take the first few dozen jobs of a broad keyword.
maxJobsPerQueryintegerStop a keyword after this many new jobs (default 50). Cost: $0.0008 per job with its description, so 50 jobs = $0.04. Raise it for full exports: data analyst alone has about 1,200 open jobs and the site serves 100 per page.
maxJobsintegerHard cap on saved jobs for the whole run across all keywords (0 = no cap).
onlyNewSinceLastRunbooleanOn: deliver only jobs that an earlier run with the same stateName has not already delivered, and skip the rest without charging. If postedWithinDays is empty it is set to 3 so each run stays small. Off (default): return every matching job.
stateNamestringOptional name for this search's memory when onlyNewSinceLastRun is on, e.g. analyst-bangalore-daily. Leave empty to derive it from the keywords, cities and filters. Use a new key to start over.
skipJobIdsarrayArray of job IDs you already have (the id field from earlier runs), e.g. ["69495391", "69497219"]. They are skipped before any detail fetch and never charged. Large arrays are fine.

Price
$0.0008 per job ($0.80 per 1,000); $0.001 per run. List prices for Apify Free and Starter plans; Scale and Business plans pay 15% to 30% less.
EventPricePer 1,000Charged when
Job$0.0008$0.80One job with its full description: title, company, salary, experience, skills, locations, posted date, apply link.
Actor Start$0.001Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).
Cost example: 50 jobs with default options cost $0.041, including any start fee. This is an illustrative record count; set explicit row and total-charge caps for your run. Apify's free plan includes $5 of usage a month, about 6,250 jobs before start fees; the Actor's own compute is included in the per-record price, and records skipped by filters, de-duplication or only-new mode are not charged.

What it is not for
Naukri/LinkedIn/Indeed (not covered); senior management and MBA roles (IIMJobs has deeper coverage). The data belongs to its publisher; the Actor reads public pages and endpoints and leaves out personal contact details.

Questions buyers ask
Is there an official foundit API?
No public one. This Actor reads the JSON that the foundit.in website itself loads and exposes it as a REST API with schedules, webhooks and only-new-jobs runs. Compared with an in-house scraper you get no maintenance, no proxies and pay-per-job pricing.
How much does it cost to scrape foundit?
$0.0008 per job with its full description plus $0.001 per run, so 100 jobs cost about $0.08 and a 50-jobs-a-day feed about $1.25 a month.
Is it legal to scrape foundit?
The Actor only reads listings that foundit shows to anyone without a login, and it leaves out the recruiter names and phone numbers the API carries. Public job data is generally collected for aggregation, research and recruiting; you remain responsible for complying with foundit's terms of use and the data-protection law that applies to you, especially if you store company data about people.
Can I export foundit jobs to Excel or Google Sheets?
Yes. Every run's dataset downloads as CSV, Excel, JSON, XML or HTML, and the task's Integrations tab appends rows to a Google Sheet after each run.
Does it return the full job description?
Yes, as HTML and plain text, plus skills, industries, functions, applicant and view counts, salary band when disclosed, the company profile and the direct apply URL.
Why are so many salaries and experience ranges null?
Most postings on foundit are syndicated from employers' career sites without a salary or stated experience band. When the recruiter hides a salary the site does too, and the Actor keeps it hidden (salaryHidden: true). Filter on salaryHidden: false and non-null salaryMinLpa for benchmarking.
Is foundit the same as Monster India?
Yes. Monster India was renamed foundit in 2022; the site is foundit.in and the data is the same board.
Does it cover foundit Gulf, Singapore, Malaysia or Indonesia?
Not yet; this Actor covers foundit.in (India, including remote and the occasional overseas posting listed there). Open an issue if you need another region.

Alternatives, honestly
OptionWhat it gives youWhere it falls short for this job
foundit.in websiteSearch for a visitorNo export; syndicated apply links are one click at a time
Naukri, LinkedIn or Indeed ActorsLarger boardsDifferent coverage; this API reads foundit only
Other foundit Actors on Apify StoreSame boardCompare salary-band handling, apply-URL resolution and price per 1,000

Published by Daemon Data (data_daemon on Apify Store). Prices, fields and example pages read from the live Apify listing on 2026-11-06; the listing is the canonical description of the Actor.

It costs $0.0008 per job with full description with the default options ($0.80 per 1,000); no login to the source site and no proxy or browser to set up on your side, and the same input runs from the Apify console, one REST call, Python, Node.js, n8n or an AI assistant through MCP.

All input fields
FieldTypeMeaning
categoriesarrayEmpty = enumerate all 18 public categories. Category slugs from Get on Board.
keywordsarrayClient-side, case/accent-insensitive substring match. OR between keywords; empty = any. No source search endpoint is used.
remoteModalitiesarrayExact source labels. fully_remote = fully remote; remote_local = remote restricted to countries; hybrid; no_remote.
remoteOnlybooleanKeep source remote=true jobs (fully_remote and remote_local). Hybrid jobs are excluded.
senioritiesarrayMatch source name or code, e.g. Junior, Semi Senior, Senior, Expert, junior, semi_senior, senior. Case/accent insensitive.
countriesarrayCountry names or common ISO codes (CL, MX, CO, PE, AR, BR, US, etc.). Match source eligibility, never infer worldwide eligibility from a remote flag.
minSalaryUsdintegerKeep jobs whose disclosed minimum monthly USD salary is at least this amount. 0 = any.
withSalaryOnlybooleanExclude jobs without a positive disclosed minimum monthly USD salary.
postedWithinDaysintegerClient-side UTC rolling window; unknown dates are excluded when active. 0 = any age.
maxItemsintegerGlobal delivered-row cap after filtering and deduplication. A later only-new run may deliver older unseen backlog left by this cap.
onlyNewbooleanPersistent delivered-ID memory in named getonbrd-jobs-state KV store. Same stateName + normalized filters share memory; skipped repeats have no job charge. Avoid overlapping runs for one feed.
stateNamestringName of your only-new feed, e.g. latam-remote-tech. Combined with normalized filters; cap changes retain memory. Ignored unless onlyNew is enabled.
skipIdsarrayExplicit exclusions; skipped IDs are neither delivered nor charged.

Price
$0.0008 per job with full description ($0.80 per 1,000); $0.001 per run. List prices for Apify Free and Starter plans; Scale and Business plans pay 15% to 30% less.
EventPricePer 1,000Charged when
Job with full description$0.0008$0.80One delivered Get on Board job including description and public company profile. Previously delivered jobs skipped in only-new mode are not charged.

Apify's free plan includes $5 of usage a month, about 6,250 job with full descriptions before start fees; the Actor's own compute is included in the per-record price, and records skipped by filters, de-duplication or only-new mode are not charged.

What it is not for
Candidate profiles; worldwide remote eligibility inferred from the remote flag; annual or original local-currency salary. The data belongs to its publisher; the Actor reads public pages and endpoints and leaves out personal contact details.

Questions buyers ask
Is salary monthly USD or yearly pay?
The public API's numeric bands are USD per month. The Actor preserves those figures without annualizing them. Employer prose may also mention local-currency compensation; it remains in the description and is not substituted into the salary object. Undisclosed salary stays null.
Does remote mean I can apply from any country?
No. remote_local restricts remote work geographically. Even for fully remote listings, use the source's countries field and the original job page to check eligibility. Country filtering never substitutes the employer's headquarters country.
¿Puedo exportar empleos remotos de Get on Board con sueldo?
Sí. Usa remoteOnly: true, countries: ["CL"] (o tu país) y minSalaryUsd. Exporta empleos de tecnología en JSON, CSV o Excel, con descripción, empresa, seniority y sueldo en USD mensuales. onlyNew: true y el mismo stateName omiten empleos ya entregados sin volver a cobrar por ellos.
Posso extrair vagas remotas do Get on Board para o Brasil?
Sim. Use countries: ["BR"] e remoteOnly: true. O filtro respeita os países elegíveis informados pela vaga; remoto não significa aceitação de candidatos do mundo inteiro. A remuneração estruturada é em USD por mês. O modo onlyNew evita cobrar novamente por vagas já entregues no mesmo feed.
Why did a repeat run return more jobs, or no jobs?
The first run may have hit its cap, leaving unseen older jobs for a later run. Once the matching source inventory is exhausted, later runs return zero until new IDs appear. A refreshed existing ID is still considered delivered. See Run summary for skipped counts and stop reasons.
Is this an official Get on Board integration?
This is an independent Actor using public pages and public JSON, with no login or private candidate data. Get on Board publishes its own API; this Actor adds Apify exports, filters, billing and persistent delivered-ID memory. Follow applicable law and source usage conditions for your intended use. Source availability and fields can change.
How do I report a problem?
Open the Issues tab with your input and run ID, without credentials. Custom extraction and integration requests can be discussed there.

Alternatives, honestly
OptionWhat it gives youWhere it falls short for this job
Get on Board public APIPublic category job data and company expansionYou maintain pagination, local filters, exports and persistent delivered-ID memory
Other Get on Board ActorsStructured jobs from the same sourceCompare description inclusion, country eligibility, only-new memory and total price

Gupy Brazil jobs as JSON API

Gupy Jobs Scraper is a pay-per-record Apify Actor by Daemon Data that returns Brazil jobs from the Gupy portal with full descriptions, city, state, workplace type and contract type as JSON, CSV or Excel. It costs $0.0008 per job with the default options ($0.80 per 1,000); no login to the source site and no proxy or browser to set up on your side, and the same input runs from the Apify console, one REST call, Python, Node.js, n8n or an AI assistant through MCP.

Daemon Data Gupy Jobs Scraper on Apify   Listing as plain text

Checked on 30 Oct 2026
the default run (the 50 newest jobs with descriptions) took 3.5 seconds on the Apify platform and cost $0.04 plus the $0.001 start fee. A full pull of every job the portal listed (9,879 jobs from 1,571 employers, published 26–29 October) took 308 seconds: 91.8% on-site, 6.7% hybrid, 1.5% remote; 85.4% regular CLT jobs, 3.7% apprenticeships, 3.5% temporary, 3.0% internships, 1.2% PJ; 76% marked open to people with disabilities (PcD; an earlier 240-job sample was misread as 30%); 42% in São Paulo state; every job had a description and deadline, 98% a city and state. All input fields
FieldTypeMeaning
searchTermsarrayOptional. Gupy matches them against job titles and descriptions, e.g. analista de dados, python, vendedor, enfermeiro. Each keyword is one search. Leave empty to get every job on the portal, newest first (about 2,700 new jobs a day in late October 2026).
statesarrayBrazilian states, e.g. São Paulo, Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro, Paraná. Accent-less names (Sao Paulo) and two-letter codes (SP, MG, RJ) work too and are mapped to Gupy's spelling. Each state is one search (combined with every keyword). Applied by Gupy before anything is downloaded.
citiesarrayCity names, e.g. São Paulo, Curitiba, Belo Horizonte. Each city is one search (combined with every keyword). Applied by Gupy before anything is downloaded.
workplaceTypesarrayOnly jobs with these workplace types (checked on each job; on 30 Oct 2026 about 96% of the newest jobs were on-site). Empty = any.
jobTypesarrayOnly these Gupy vacancy types (checked on each job). Empty = any. effective is a regular (CLT) job; legal_entity is a PJ contract.
pwdOnlybooleanOnly jobs the employer marked as open to people with disabilities (acceptsPwd).
postedWithinDaysintegerOnly jobs published on Gupy in the last N days (e.g. 1 for a daily feed, 7 for weekly). Jobs come newest first, so the search stops at the first page of older jobs. 0 or empty = any date.
locationsarrayOnly jobs whose city or state contains one of these words (accent-insensitive), e.g. Campinas, Paraná. remote matches remote jobs. Unlike states and cities, this is checked after download; use it to combine a keyword search with several places in one run.
includeDescriptionbooleanFull job description as plain text (description). It costs the same either way; turn it off for smaller files.
maxResultsPerSearchintegerCap for each keyword × place search. Newest jobs come first. 0 = no cap (the portal lists its newest 10,000 jobs, about six days of postings on 30 Oct 2026).
maxResultsintegerStop after this many saved jobs. 0 or empty = no total cap (the run's maximum cost still applies).
onlyNewSinceLastRunbooleanFor schedules: remember delivered job ids (in a named key-value store in your account) and save only jobs that earlier runs with the same settings did not deliver. Skipped jobs are not charged.
stateNamestringName of the only-new memory. Empty = derived from the keywords, places and filters. Give two schedules the same name to share one memory.
skipIdsarrayGupy job ids you already have (the id field). They are neither saved nor charged.

Price
$0.0008 per job ($0.80 per 1,000); $0.001 per run. List prices for Apify Free and Starter plans; Scale and Business plans pay 15% to 30% less.
EventPricePer 1,000Charged when
Job$0.0008$0.80One Gupy job saved to the dataset: id, URL, title, company and career site, city, state, workplace type (remote/hybrid/on-site), job type (CLT, internship, apprentice, temporary, PJ, ...), PcD flag, published date, application deadline and the full description. Skipped or filtered jobs are never charged.
Actor Start$0.001Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).
Cost example: 50 jobs with default options cost $0.041, including any start fee. This is an illustrative record count; set explicit row and total-charge caps for your run. Apify's free plan includes $5 of usage a month, about 6,250 jobs before start fees; the Actor's own compute is included in the per-record price, and records skipped by filters, de-duplication or only-new mode are not charged.

Saved inputs you can run with one click on Apify (Examples tab); each has its own page:

Questions buyers ask
Is there an official Gupy jobs API?
Gupy offers no public job-search API. This Actor reads the JSON page data that portal.gupy.io's own search page loads (robots.txt allows the whole portal), and exposes it as a REST API with schedules, webhooks and only-new runs, so you do not maintain a scraper or proxies yourself.
How much does it cost to scrape Gupy?
$0.0008 per job with its description plus $0.001 per run, so 50 jobs cost about $0.04, every job posted on the portal in a day about $2.20, and a weekly keyword × state feed a few cents a month.
Is it legal to scrape Gupy?
The Actor only reads job postings that Gupy shows to anyone without a login, through pages its robots.txt allows, and it collects no data about candidates or recruiters. Public job-posting data is generally collected for aggregation, research and recruiting; you remain responsible for complying with Gupy's terms of use and the law that applies to you (including the LGPD, which this Actor's output, company job postings, does not concern).
Can I get every job posted on Gupy today?
Yes: leave the keywords empty, set postedWithinDays: 1 and maxResultsPerSearch: 0. That was about 2,700 jobs (about $2.20) on 29 Oct 2026. Switch on only-new mode so a daily schedule delivers each job once.
Does it return the salary?
No. The Gupy portal does not show salaries; the description sometimes mentions one.
Can I filter by remote jobs or by internships?
Yes, with workplaceTypes: ["remote"] and jobTypes: ["internship"]. Both are checked on each job after download (the portal's search cannot filter them), so combine them with a keyword or a state to keep the run short. Of the 9,879 jobs the portal listed on 29 Oct 2026, 1.5% were remote, 6.7% hybrid and 3.0% internships.
How many jobs are posted on Gupy per day, and what do they look like?
About 2,700 on a weekday in late October 2026 (2,692 on Tuesday 27 and 2,793 on Wednesday 28 October). Shares by workplace type, vacancy type, PcD flag, state, city, employer and role, with the analysis code, are in the study Brazil job postings on Gupy: what 9,879 new jobs in October 2026 show (FAQ in English and Portuguese).
Can I export Gupy jobs to Excel or Google Sheets?
Yes. Every run's dataset downloads as CSV, Excel, JSON, XML or HTML, and the task's Integrations tab appends rows to a Google Sheet after each run.

Alternatives, honestly
OptionWhat it gives youWhere it falls short for this job

Other Gupy Actors on Apify StoreSame sourceCompare description coverage, only-new memory and price per 1,000

# Hirist tech job listings as JSON API | Daemon Data

Hirist tech job listings as JSON API

Hirist.tech Jobs Scraper is a pay-per-record Apify Actor by Daemon Data that returns India IT and tech jobs with full descriptions, skills, salary when disclosed as JSON, CSV or Excel. It costs $0.002 per job with the default options ($2.00 per 1,000); no login to the source site and no proxy or browser to set up on your side, and the same input runs from the Apify console, one REST call, Python, Node.js, n8n or an AI assistant through MCP.

Input and how to call it

Example input. Fields and pricing were checked against the public listing on 2026-11-06; this build does not run paid example searches.

{
  "queries": [
    "python developer"
  ],
  "locations": [
    "Bangalore"
  ],
  "postedWithinDays": 7,
  "includeDescription": true,
  "maxJobsPerQuery": 50
}

One HTTP call starts a run, waits for it and returns the records (token from console.apify.com):

curl -X POST "https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/data_daemon~hirist-jobs-scraper/run-sync-get-dataset-items?token=YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"queries": ["python developer"], "locations": ["Bangalore"], "postedWithinDays": 7, "includeDescription": true, "maxJobsPerQuery": 50}'

Python: ApifyClient(token).actor("data_daemon/hirist-jobs-scraper").call(run_input=...). Python example · Node.js example · n8n workflow.
AI assistant (MCP): add the remote server https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=data_daemon/hirist-jobs-scraper with header Authorization: Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN in Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or VS Code and ask for the data in plain words.

All input fields
FieldTypeMeaning
queriesarrayOne Hirist.tech search per keyword, e.g. python developer, data engineer, devops, react native, sap abap. Use role or skill words; put cities in locations. Several specific keywords beat one broad one. A job found by two keywords is saved and charged once.
allJobsbooleanIgnore the keywords and deliver every job Hirist lists in the posting window: a full-board feed for job aggregators and market tracking. Hirist posts about 140 jobs a day (measured 26 Oct 2026). Uses postedWithinDays (the last 3 days when empty), locations, experience and maxJobs; the per-keyword cap does not apply. Combine with Only new jobs since the last run for a daily feed of every new job. You can also put * in the keywords.
locationsarrayOptional. Cities as Hirist lists them: Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Gurgaon, Noida, Mumbai, Remote, Anywhere in India. Case-insensitive substring match on the job's listed locations; a single known city is also applied server-side for speed. Leave empty for all of India.
minExperienceintegerOnly jobs whose experience range reaches at least this many years. Integer 0-40.
maxExperienceintegerOnly jobs whose experience range starts at or below this many years. Integer 0-40.
postedWithinDaysintegerOnly jobs posted in the last N days. Integer 1-365. Days count in India time, so 1 means today only: use 3 with a daily only-new schedule, 7 for a weekly report. Leave empty for all open jobs.
includeDescriptionbooleanOn (default): full, untruncated description as HTML and plain text, plus the company profile. No extra charge since 2 November 2026. Off: listing fields only, about twice as fast, which is enough for counting jobs or sizing a market.
maxJobsPerQueryintegerStop a keyword after this many new jobs (default 40). Cost: $0.002 per job, description included, so 40 jobs = $0.08. Raise it for full exports: data engineer alone has about 3,400 open jobs.
maxJobsintegerHard cap on saved jobs for the whole run across all keywords (0 = no cap).
onlyNewSinceLastRunbooleanOn: deliver only jobs that an earlier run with the same stateName has not already delivered, and skip the rest without charging. If postedWithinDays is empty it is set to 3 so each run stays small. Off (default): return every matching job.
stateNamestringOptional name for this search's memory when onlyNewSinceLastRun is on, e.g. python-bangalore-daily. Leave empty to derive it from the keywords, locations and experience filters. Use a new key to start over.
skipJobIdsarrayJob IDs you already have (the id field from earlier runs). They are skipped before any detail fetch and never charged. Large lists are fine.
sitestringKeep hirist (default) for IT and tech jobs. Set iimjobs only for management, finance and MBA jobs from IIMJobs.com; the output format is the same, and the dedicated IIMJobs Jobs Scraper documents it.

Price
$0.002 per job ($2.00 per 1,000); $0.001 per run. List prices for Apify Free and Starter plans; Scale and Business plans pay 15% to 30% less.
EventPricePer 1,000Charged when
Job$0.002$2.00One job with its full description and company profile: title, company, salary, skills, locations, applicants, AmbitionBox rating.
Actor Start$0.001Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).
Cost example: 50 jobs with default options cost $0.101, including any start fee. This is an illustrative record count; set explicit row and total-charge caps for your run. Apify's free plan includes $5 of usage a month, about 2,500 jobs before start fees; the Actor's own compute is included in the per-record price, and records skipped by filters, de-duplication or only-new mode are not charged.

What it is not for
Non-tech roles (use IIMJobs). The data belongs to its publisher; the Actor reads public pages and endpoints and leaves out personal contact details.

Questions buyers ask
How much does it cost to scrape Hirist jobs?
$0.002 per job with its full description (plus $0.001 per run), so 100 jobs cost $0.20 and a 34-jobs-a-day feed about $2 a month.
Is there a Hirist API?
Not a public one. This Actor reads the JSON the hirist.tech site itself loads and exposes it as a REST API with schedules, webhooks and only-new-jobs runs.
Is Hirist.tech real or fake?
Hirist.tech is a legitimate Indian tech job board owned by Info Edge, the Naukri group. Every row links to the original posting, so you can verify it.
Can I filter by city and experience?
Yes: locations, minExperience, maxExperience and postedWithinDays. A single city is passed to Hirist's own search; several cities are matched on our side.
Does it return the full job description?
Yes, as HTML and plain text, untruncated, plus skills, applicant and view counts, salary in LPA when shown and the AmbitionBox company profile when one exists.
Why is recruiter.name null?
Hirist shows recruiter names only to logged-in users. The Actor keeps the recruiter's designation and does not work around the site's choice. Company name and domain come from the job; an AmbitionBox profile is included only when its identity matches.
Hirist vs Naukri?
Hirist is tech-only and every posting carries skill tags and an experience band, which makes it cleaner for skills analytics. Naukri is broader and noisier.
Can I get Hirist and IIMJobs jobs together?
Yes. IIMJobs Jobs Scraper uses the same output schema and the same onlyNewSinceLastRun mode, so one pipeline handles both boards.

Alternatives, honestly
OptionWhat it gives youWhere it falls short for this job
Hirist.tech websiteSearch and alerts for a logged-in userNo bulk export or API
Other Hirist Actors on Apify StoreSame boardCompare full-description coverage, AmbitionBox fields, only-new mode, price
Build your own scraperFull controlMaintenance of endpoints, pagination and de-duplication is on you

Questions buyers ask
How much does it cost to scrape IIMJobs?
$0.002 per job with its full description (plus $0.001 per run), so 100 jobs cost $0.20 and a 50-jobs-a-day feed about $3 a month.
Is there an official IIMJobs API?
No public one. This Actor reads the JSON that the iimjobs.com website itself loads and exposes it as a REST API with schedules, webhooks and only-new-jobs runs.
Which roles does IIMJobs cover?
Management, consulting, finance, CA/CFA, sales, marketing, HR and MBA-track roles at Indian and global companies, mostly 2 to 25 years of experience.
Does it return the full job description?
Yes, as HTML and plain text, plus skills, applicant and view counts, salary in LPA when disclosed and the AmbitionBox company profile when one exists.
Why is recruiter.name null?
IIMJobs shows recruiter names only to logged-in users. The Actor keeps the recruiter's designation and does not work around the site's choice. Company name and domain come from the job; an AmbitionBox profile is included only when its identity matches.
IIMJobs vs Naukri: which should I scrape?
IIMJobs is curated mid-to-senior management, finance and consulting hiring. Naukri is all levels. For CXO, VP, CA/CFA and MBA roles, IIMJobs has far less noise.
Can I get IIMJobs and Hirist jobs together?
Yes. Hirist.tech Jobs Scraper uses the same output schema and the same onlyNewSinceLastRun mode, so one pipeline handles both boards.
Do I need a proxy or login?
No.

Alternatives, honestly
OptionWhat it gives youWhere it falls short for this job
IIMJobs website and recruiter dashboardSearch and email alerts for a logged-in userNo export, no API, no applicant counts in bulk
Other IIMJobs Actors on Apify StoreSimilar scraping of the same boardCompare fields (salary, AmbitionBox profile, only-new mode) and price per 1,000
Build your own scraperFull controlThe board's JSON endpoints change; you maintain pagination, de-duplication and scheduling

One HTTP call starts a run, waits for it and returns the records (token from console.apify.com):

curl -X POST "https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/data_daemon~importyeti-scraper/run-sync-get-dataset-items?token=YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"companies": ["walmart"], "output": "shipments", "maxResults": 100}'

Python: ApifyClient(token).actor("data_daemon/importyeti-scraper").call(run_input=...). Python example · Node.js example · n8n workflow.
AI assistant (MCP): add the remote server https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=data_daemon/importyeti-scraper with header Authorization: Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN in Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or VS Code and ask for the data in plain words.

All input fields
FieldTypeMeaning
companiesarrayCompany names or ImportYeti URLs, e.g. Walmart, ikea-supply, https://www.importyeti.com/company/wal-mart. A name is turned into the page address (Ikea Supply becomes /company/ikea-supply); if it is not found, copy the exact URL from importyeti.com.
suppliersarraySupplier names or ImportYeti supplier URLs, e.g. https://www.importyeti.com/supplier/foxconn. Shipments then list the US importers they ship to.
outputstringshipments: one row per recent bill of lading (the page lists the 50 newest). profile: one row per company with totals, top suppliers (or, for supplier pages, top US buyers), HS codes, port lanes and monthly shipments for up to the last 24 months that had shipments.
shippedWithinDaysintegerShipments mode: keep bills of lading dated within the last N days.
maxShipmentsPerCompanyintegerUp to 50 (ImportYeti shows the 50 newest bills of lading per company).
topSuppliersintegerProfile mode: how many suppliers (company pages) or US buyers (supplier pages) to include, up to 50, largest first.
maxResultsintegerStop after this many saved rows (default 100). 0 = no cap.
onlyNewSinceLastRunbooleanShipments: skip bills of lading delivered by earlier runs. Profiles: deliver a company again only after it has a newer shipment. Memory is kept in a key-value store named importyeti-state (skipped rows are not charged).
stateNamestringBy default it follows the output and the company list.
skipIdsarrayBill of lading numbers (shipments) or company/<slug> ids (profiles) you already have. Not saved, not charged.

Price
$0.002 per shipment ($2.00 per 1,000); $0.01 per company profile ($10.00 per 1,000); $0.001 per run. List prices for Apify Free and Starter plans; Scale and Business plans pay 15% to 30% less.
EventPricePer 1,000Charged when

Company profile$0.01$10.00One company profile saved to the dataset: totals, up to 50 suppliers with volumes and HS codes, HS-code breakdown, port lanes and the 24-month shipment trend.
Actor Start$0.001Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).
Cost example: 50 shipments with default options cost $0.101, including any start fee. This is an illustrative record count; set explicit row and total-charge caps for your run. Apify's free plan includes $5 of usage a month, about 2,500 shipments before start fees; the Actor's own compute is included in the per-record price, and records skipped by filters, de-duplication or only-new mode are not charged.

# India IPO GMP & subscription data API (JSON) | Daemon Data

Source: https://datadmon.github.io/actors/india-ipo-tracker/

India IPO GMP & subscription data API (JSON)

India IPO Tracker API is a pay-per-record Apify Actor by Daemon Data that returns live IPO GMP, QIB/NII/retail subscription, calendar, listing data as JSON, CSV or Excel. It costs $0.003 per ipo report row with the default options ($3.00 per 1,000); no login to the source site and no proxy or browser to set up on your side, and the same input runs from the Apify console, one REST call, Python, Node.js, n8n or an AI assistant through MCP.

Daemon Data India IPO Tracker API on Apify   Listing as plain text

Checked on 18 Oct 2026
A live GMP report had about 50 rows (every upcoming, open and recently listed IPO), the calendar about 30, and the year-to-date subscription, IPO-list and listing-performance reports about 280 to 300 rows each. The default run (GMP plus calendar, about 80 rows) costs about $0.25 and finishes in under 30 seconds.

Why teams use it
Two sources joined for you. GMP and subscription come from different public IPO reports. Every record carries the same stable slug (e.g. paras-healthcare-ipo), so you can join reports without fuzzy name matching.
Mainboard and SME in one feed, with ISIN, BSE scrip code and NSE symbol on subscription, IPO-list and listing-performance rows for joining to your security master.
Cheap to poll. Plain HTTP, no browser: a GMP refresh costs about 15 cents.
Never fails on input. Unknown options are ignored with a warning and the run still succeeds, so schedules and webhooks keep working.
No contract. Pay per row, cancel by stopping the schedule.

Output fields
The most useful top-level fields with values from a real record; the full list is reportType, source, sourceReportId, ipoName, slug, url, category, status, statusLabel, gmp, gmpPercent, gmpText, rating, subscriptionText, issuePrice, issueSizeCr, lotSize, priceToEarnings, openDate, closeDate, allotmentDate, listingDate, updatedOn, anchorInvestors, fields, meta, scrapedAt, date, dateLabel, opening, closing, allotment, refundUnblock, listing, holiday, statusText, exchange, listingPrice, listingGainPercent, qibX, sNiiX, bNiiX, niiX, retailX, employeeX, totalX, applications, subscriptionAsOn, isin, bseScripCode, nseSymbol, shareholderX, listingAt, listingOpenPrice, listingOpenGainPercent, listingClosePrice, currentPriceBse, currentPriceNse, currentGainPercent, symbol, subscriptionX, estimatedListingPrice, listingDayClosePrice, closingGainPercent, lastTradedPrice, lastTradedGainPercent, listingVsEstimate, lastUpdated. All input fields
FieldTypeMeaning
reportsarrayWhich IPO datasets to extract. Each produces its own reportType records. Default: live GMP (gmp) plus the IPO event calendar (calendar), about 80 rows, about $0.25 at $0.003 per row. Add subscription for QIB/NII/Retail multiples (every IPO of the current calendar year so far, about 300 rows) and currentIpos for status, price band, lot size and dates (about 300 rows). gmpPerformance compares the last GMP with the actual listing price (about 280 rows per year).
categorystringMainboard IPOs, SME IPOs, or both (all). Applies to every report except the event calendar.
yearintegerCalendar year (YYYY, 2000 to next year) for the year-scoped reports. Leave empty for the current year (recommended). Only gmpPerformance has full history for past years (2025 returns about 380 rows); ipoList, subscription, listingPerformance and currentIpos return only a handful of rows for past years because the sources publish them for the current calendar year. gmp and calendar are always live and ignore this field. Invalid values are ignored with a warning, the run does not fail.
includeIpoDetailsbooleanAlso fetch each IPO's detail page (price band, lot size, timetable, reservation, anchor investors, financials, objects of the issue). Emits one extra ipoDetail record per IPO, charged $0.015 per detail page on top of the rows.
maxItemsintegerStop after this many records (0 = no limit). Each record costs $0.003; each IPO detail page $0.015.

Price
$0.003 per ipo report row ($3.00 per 1,000); $0.015 per ipo detail page ($15.00 per 1,000). List prices for Apify Free and Starter plans; Scale and Business plans pay 15% to 30% less.

What it is not for
Non-Indian IPOs; secondary-market prices (use Tickertape). The data belongs to its publisher; the Actor reads public pages and endpoints and leaves out personal contact details.

Questions buyers ask
How much does it cost to get Indian IPO GMP and subscription data?
The default run (live GMP + calendar, about 80 rows) costs about $0.25 at $0.003 per row. A GMP-only poll is about $0.15. Full IPO detail pages cost $0.015 per IPO.
How often is the data updated?
Every run reads the sources live. Schedule it every 30 minutes during IPO bidding hours for a near-real-time feed.
Does it cover SME IPOs?
Yes. Set category to sme, mainboard or all. Every record carries category so you can also filter afterwards.
Can I get past years?
Only for gmpPerformance (GMP vs listing price), which has full history per calendar year through the year field. The other year-scoped reports are published by the sources for the current calendar year only, so past years return just a few rows.
Is there an IPO GMP API?
There is no official one: GMP is an unofficial grey-market indicator, and BSE and NSE do not publish it. This Actor works as an IPO GMP API: call it through the Apify API (run-sync-get-dataset-items returns the rows in the response), from Python or Node.js, or from n8n, Make, Zapier or an AI agent, and get live GMP, subscription, calendar and listing results as JSON.
How accurate is IPO GMP?
In 2026 the last GMP before listing missed the actual listing gain by 8.6 percentage points on average (7.0 for mainboard, 9.6 for SME IPOs), and 69% of IPOs listed within 10 points of their GMP. See "How accurate is IPO GMP?" above; the gmpPerformance report lets you recompute it for any year.
Do I need a proxy or login?
No. The sources answer plain HTTP requests, so runs finish in seconds.
What happens if a source is down?
Reports that cannot be fetched are logged and skipped; the run still succeeds with whatever was collected. Only when every requested report is unreachable and nothing was collected does the run fail with a clear message, so your webhook can alert you.

Alternatives, honestly
OptionWhat it gives youWhere it falls short for this job
Broker APIs (for example Upstox)Official IPO calendar and some subscription figuresNo grey market premium; one broker's view
IPO tracking websitesGMP and subscription pages for peopleNo JSON, no stable key across reports, no schedule
BSE and NSE websitesOfficial bid data while an issue is openNo GMP; bot protection; no history joined to listing results

Free IPO GMP accuracy explorer
Compare 2026 IPO GMP with actual listing gain: filter mainboard/SME, issue size and GMP bands, inspect the methodology and download CSV or JSON.

# India Jobs Feed: 10 boards in one JSON feed | Daemon Data

Source: https://datadmon.github.io/actors/india-jobs-feed/

India Jobs Feed: 10 boards in one JSON feed
India Jobs Feed runs one job search across ten Indian job boards (Naukri, IIMJobs, Hirist, foundit, Instahyre, Shine, Cutshort, Apna, WorkIndia and Unstop) and returns the results in one schema: job title, company, city, remote/onsite, experience range, salary in LPA (monthly pay converted, odd units flagged), skills, posting date, job link and, optionally, the full description. The same job posted on two boards is kept once and the other listing goes into alsoListedOn. An only-new mode turns it into a daily feed of new jobs from all ten boards. No login, no subscription: you pay only each board's own per-job price.
Open India Jobs Feed | Naukri + 9 Indian Job Boards in One API on Apify
Price and coverage
No fee of its own. Searches run the selected board Actors in your Apify account at each board’s price, including any start fee. Platform usage may apply. Boards: Naukri, IIMJobs, Hirist, foundit, Instahyre, Shine, Cutshort, Apna, WorkIndia and Unstop. Salary is normalized to LPA; cross-board duplicates are folded conservatively. Source salary and description coverage varies.
Example input
{
  "keywords": [
    "data analyst"
  ],
  "postedWithinDays": 7,
  "maxJobsPerBoard": 20
}
Run through the Apify REST API or SDK; download the resulting dataset as JSON, CSV or Excel. Set board, row and total-charge limits before searching. Use only-new mode with a stable state name for repeated feeds.
Public example pages
Data analyst jobs in Bangalore from 9 Indian job boards
New jobs in India in the last 24 hours, all 9 boards
Questions and limits
Is there an API for Indian job boards like IIMJobs, foundit or Apna?
We found no documented public API for reading job listings on these boards (checked November 2026). India Jobs Feed gives you one REST API over ten of them: start a run with POST https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/data_daemon~india-jobs-feed/runs and read the dataset items, or use the Apify Python/JavaScript clients, Make, Zapier, n8n or the Apify MCP server.
How is a job posted on two boards handled?
When the title and the named company match on two boards and the job is in at least one of the same cities (Bangalore and Bengaluru count as one), the job is kept once, from the board listed first in boards, and the other listing (board, link, id) goes into alsoListedOn. Jobs from a hidden or "confidential" employer are never folded, and the same title from one employer in different cities stays as separate rows.
Why is the salary empty for some jobs?
Many employers hide pay (common on IIMJobs, Hirist and Instahyre). Pay quoted per hour, per task or in another currency is kept in salaryText but not converted. Apna shows what the employer typed; when an Apna "monthly" figure looks yearly (₹1.5 lakh or more a month for an entry-level job), it is left unconverted with a salaryNote.
Why does a board show fewer jobs than I expected?
Each board has its own search; a keyword that suits Hirist (kubernetes) may find nothing on WorkIndia. The status message and RUN-SUMMARY list jobs per board. Naukri, LinkedIn and Indeed are not included.
Is it legal to scrape job listings?
The feed reads publicly visible job listings, the same information any visitor sees, without logging in; it does not collect recruiter contact details. Check that your use complies with the laws that apply to you.
Something is wrong or missing?
Open an issue on the Issues tab with your input and the run link, and it will be looked at. Custom fields or another Indian board can be discussed there too.
Public status, schema and absence of an own pricing record checked 2026-11-06. See the public listing for the complete input and latest terms.

# New company registrations in India (MCA) API | Daemon Data

Source: https://datadmon.github.io/actors/india-new-company-registrations/

New company registrations in India (MCA) API

India New Company Registrations is a pay-per-record Apify Actor by Daemon Data that returns newly incorporated Indian companies from the MCA register: CIN, type, RoC, state, NIC activity, capital, registered office as JSON, CSV or Excel. It costs $0.003 per company with the default options ($3.00 per 1,000); no login to the source site and no proxy or browser to set up on your side, and the same input runs from the Apify console, one REST call, Python, Node.js, n8n or an AI assistant through MCP.

Daemon Data India New Company Registrations on Apify   Listing as plain text

Why teams use it
Daily feed shape. The register lists incorporations by date. Read the newest date (recentDates: 1) or the last three with only-new mode, and nothing is charged twice.
Filter before paying. Company type, state (both from the CIN) and name keywords are checked before any company page is opened; activity keywords and RoC names are checked on the page. Rows outside your filters are never charged.
Business facts only. The row is the company: CIN, type, RoC, state, activity, capital, registered office. No personal data of directors.
Cheaper than the alternatives. Store actors for MCA data charge $3-10 per 1,000 and most focus on director lookups; this feed is $3 per 1,000 at the FREE tier and less on paid plans.

Output fields
The most useful top-level fields with values from a real record; the full list is cin, name, url, registrationDate, registrationNumber, status, companyType, companyTypeCode, listed, roc, state, cinStateCode, category, subCategory, companyClass, activity, activityUrl, nicCode, listingStatus, authorizedCapitalInr, paidUpCapitalInr, registeredAddress, pincode, directorsCount, lastAgmDate, lastFinancialsDate, detailsIncluded, source, scrapedAt, isCached, dataStatus, collectedAt, servedAt. Per-field notes and the OpenAPI definition are on the Apify API page.

Input and how to call it

Example input. Fields and pricing were checked against the public listing on 2026-11-06; this build does not run paid example searches.

{
  "recentDates": 3,
  "companyTypes": [
    "opc",
    "private"
  ],
  "states": [
    "Karnataka"
  ],
  "includeDetails": true,
  "maxResults": 50
}

One HTTP call starts a run, waits for it and returns the records (token from console.apify.com):

curl -X POST "https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/data_daemon~india-new-company-registrations/run-sync-get-dataset-items?token=YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"recentDates": 3, "companyTypes": ["opc", "private"], "states": ["Karnataka"], "includeDetails": true, "maxResults": 50}'

Python: ApifyClient(token).actor("data_daemon/india-new-company-registrations").call(run_input=...). Python example · Node.js example · n8n workflow.
AI assistant (MCP): add the remote server https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=data_daemon/india-new-company-registrations with header Authorization: Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN in Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or VS Code and ask for the data in plain words.

All input fields
FieldTypeMeaning
recentDatesintegerTake the N newest incorporation dates the register lists (1 = the latest day, usually 300-1,000 companies). Ignored when dates or fromDate/toDate are set. For a daily schedule use 2 or 3 with only-new mode, so late additions to earlier days are picked up once. During a source outage this selects the newest available real data; cached rows are explicitly dated and marked.
datesarraySpecific incorporation dates as YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-10-28. Each date is read in full (all pages).
fromDatestringStart of a date range (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive). Every listed incorporation date from here to toDate (or the newest) is read.
toDatestringEnd of the date range (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive).
companyTypesarrayOnly these types (read from the CIN before any page is opened; filtered-out companies are not charged). Empty = all.
statesarrayOnly companies whose state or RoC contains one of these words, e.g. Maharashtra, Karnataka, Delhi, KA, RoC-Bangalore. State names and codes are matched against the state code in the CIN before any company page is opened (fast); RoC names and LLPs are checked on the company page. Rows outside the filter are never charged.
activityKeywordsarrayOnly companies whose NIC activity description or 5-digit NIC code contains one of these, e.g. software, real estate, 62011, retail trade. Checked on the company page.
nameKeywordsarrayOnly companies whose name contains one of these words, e.g. foundation, technologies, hospitality. Checked before any page is opened.
includeDetailsbooleanRead the company page for status, RoC, state, category, class, activity, capital, registered office and the number of directors. Off = listing fields only (name, CIN and what the CIN encodes: type, NIC code, state code, year), which is faster. Same price either way. Fallback sources may supply fewer details; absent fields stay null and detailsIncluded indicates whether a public detail profile was read.
maxResultsintegerStop after this many saved companies (default 25, about $0.076 including run start). 0 = no cap (the run maximum cost still applies).
onlyNewSinceLastRunbooleanFor schedules: remember delivered CINs (in a named key-value store in your account) and save only companies that earlier runs with the same filters did not deliver. Skipped companies are not charged.
stateNamestringName of the only-new memory. Empty = derived from the filters (dates do not change it). Give two schedules the same name to share one memory.
skipIdsarrayCINs (or LLPINs) you already have. They are neither saved nor charged.

Price
$0.003 per company ($3.00 per 1,000); $0.001 per run. List prices for Apify Free and Starter plans; Scale and Business plans pay 15% to 30% less.
EventPricePer 1,000Charged when
Company$0.003$3.00One newly incorporated company saved to the dataset: name, CIN, incorporation date, type, RoC, state, category and class, NIC activity, authorised and paid-up capital, registered office with PIN code, number of directors. Companies skipped by only-new mode, skipIds or the filters are never charged.
Actor Start$0.001Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).
Cost example: 50 companys with default options cost $0.151, including any start fee. This is an illustrative record count; set explicit row and total-charge caps for your run. Apify's free plan includes $5 of usage a month, about 1,666 companys before start fees; the Actor's own compute is included in the per-record price, and records skipped by filters, de-duplication or only-new mode are not charged.

# Instahyre startup tech jobs as JSON API | Daemon Data

Source: https://datadmon.github.io/actors/instahyre-jobs-scraper/

Instahyre startup tech jobs as JSON API

Instahyre Jobs Scraper is a pay-per-record Apify Actor by Daemon Data that returns India tech jobs from product companies and startups by skill, city, experience and company size, full descriptions included as JSON, CSV or Excel. It costs $0.0008 per job with the default options ($0.80 per 1,000); no login to the source site and no proxy or browser to set up on your side, and the same input runs from the Apify console, one REST call, Python, Node.js, n8n or an AI assistant through MCP.

Daemon Data Instahyre Jobs Scraper on Apify   Listing as plain text

Checked on 21 Oct 2026
python matched 4,300 open Instahyre jobs (2,600 in Bangalore), react 1,600, data science 8,000 (title and skill-tag matching is broad), devops work-from-home 134. The default run (50 python jobs with descriptions) took 22 seconds on the Apify platform on 30 Oct 2026 and cost $0.04 plus the $0.001 start fee; 30 of the 50 were in Bangalore and 22 came from companies under 100 people.

Who uses it, for what
You areWhat you get
Tech recruiters and staffing agenciesA daily list of new openings by skill, city, experience band and company size, with the hiring company's headcount and founding year, so you know which startups and product companies are hiring right now.
Job aggregators and HR-tech productsInstahyre as a source with stable job IDs (dedupKey), full JD text, de-duplication across keywords and runs, and an API you can call on a schedule. Same conventions as the IIMJobs, Hirist and Foundit Actors by the same publisher.
B2B sales and lead generationA company hiring five backend engineers is buying cloud, tooling and services. Each row carries the company name, size, tagline, website and logo.
Workforce and market analystsDemand by skill, city, experience band and company size over time; share of remote roles; which skills large companies ask for versus startups.
Candidates and job-alert buildersYour own alert for golang jobs at small companies in Bangalore, delivered to a sheet, Slack or email the moment they appear.
AI agents (MCP)Ask Claude or ChatGPT "new Python jobs in Hyderabad at startups posted this week" and let it call this Actor through Apify's MCP server.

One HTTP call starts a run, waits for it and returns the records (token from console.apify.com):

curl -X POST "https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/data_daemon~instahyre-jobs-scraper/run-sync-get-dataset-items?token=YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"queries": ["python"], "locations": ["Bangalore"], "companySizes": ["small", "medium"], "includeDescription": true, "maxJobsPerQuery": 50}'
